units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 4:8">Targ. Cant. IV, 8</cite>, sq.—
R. Hash. 26ᵃ היו קורין לכלה נ׳ I heard them call a bride nin’fe.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 71">Gen. R. s. 71</cite> (play on <he>נ̇פ̇תולי</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 30:8">Gen. XXX, 8</cite>) <he>נ׳ היה לי ליעשות וכ׳</he> (not … <he>פה</he>) I ought to have been made a bride before my sister; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 127">Yalk. Gen. 127</cite> <cite ref="L00492"><he>לינפה</he></cite> (corr. acc.).
Ex. R. s. 36, beg. (ref. to יפה ניף, Ps. XLVIII, 3) לשון יוני … נימפי (some ed. נִמְ׳) in Greek they call a bride nymphe.

<cite ref="Psalms 48:3">Ib.</cite> s. 52, end (ref. to Ps. l. c.) <he>קלי נינ׳</he> ed. Const. (missing in ed.) καλὴ νύμφη, the beautiful bride; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 41">Pesik. R. s. 41</cite> <cite ref="S01274"><he>קלוניפו</he></cite> (corr. acc.); Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 18 (ref. to <cite ref="N01086"><he>נֹפֶת</he></cite>, <cite ref="Song of Songs 4:11">Cant. IV, 11</cite>) <he>כלה נופי</he>; ed. Bub. ib. 9 <cite ref="S01274"><he>קלונינפי</he></cite>, read <he>קלי נ׳</he>.—[<cite ref="Yoma 10a:4">Yoma 10ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="N00740"><he>נִיפָר</he></cite>.]
